import must come BEFORE module docblock in Lean 4
INT16_MIN/MAX: use simp only [INT16_MIN, INT16_MAX] at * before omega for multi-const goals
abbrev is transparent to omega; simp-unfold first is safer for multi-constant proofs
prefix is reserved in Lean 4 — use pfx/sfx
CRC-64-WE is MSBIT-first: use <<< left-shift, check bit 63
linarith NOT available without Mathlib — use omega, Int.add_nonneg, Rat.le_trans etc.
0 ≤ u*u for u:Int: by_cases h:0≤u; Int.mul_nonneg h h; or Int.neg_mul_neg + Int.neg_nonneg.mpr
Rat div by Nat.cast 1: use Rat.inv_def; rfl for (1:Rat)⁻¹=1, then Rat.mul_one
bsFold proofs: use show foldl bsUpdate (bsUpdate s u) rest = bsFold (bsUpdate s u) rest from rfl
